# adds_acl_export (Data Source)

Exports the explicit (non-inherited) access control entries of one object, or every object below a path, as ready-to-use `adds_acl` configuration. Built for lifting an existing domain's delegation into Terraform: inherited ACEs are ignored, the **Protect from accidental deletion** ACE is excluded (it is managed separately), SIDs and GUIDs are resolved to names, and each object's `inheritance_blocked` state is captured so the whole configuration can be replicated.

The rendered configuration is exposed as `hcl`; pair it with the `local_file` resource to write a `.tf` file, or use `terraform output`:

```terraform
data "adds_acl_export" "tree" {
  path         = "" # the domain root
  recursive    = true
  object_types = ["organizationalUnit", "container"]
}

resource "local_file" "acls" {
  filename = "${path.module}/imported-acls.tf"
  content  = data.adds_acl_export.tree.hcl
}
```

`target` in the rendered blocks uses the portable form (a slash path for OUs, otherwise a relative distinguished name), so an export replays against another domain with the same relative structure. Recursion currently returns every object type by default; narrow it with `object_types`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Export the explicit ACLs of an entire OU subtree and write them to a .tf file for review.
data "adds_acl_export" "servers" {
  path         = "Contoso/Servers"
  recursive    = true
  object_types = ["organizationalUnit", "container"]
}

# Persist the rendered adds_acl configuration. Requires the hashicorp/local provider.
resource "local_file" "servers_acls" {
  filename = "${path.module}/imported/servers-acls.tf"
  content  = data.adds_acl_export.servers.hcl
}

# Export a single object's ACL (no recursion).
data "adds_acl_export" "one_ou" {
  path = "Contoso/Servers"
}

# Export every object's ACL in the whole domain, using the domain root as the path.
data "adds_domain" "current" {}

data "adds_acl_export" "domain" {
  path      = data.adds_domain.current.domain_path
  recursive = true
}

output "domain_acl_hcl" {
  value = data.adds_acl_export.domain.hcl
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `include_empty` (Boolean) Include objects that have no explicit ACEs and do not block inheritance. Defaults to `false`, because an object with nothing to replicate would render an empty authoritative `adds_acl` that prunes its DACL on apply.
- `object_types` (Set of String) Restrict the export to these Active Directory structural class names (`lDAPDisplayName`), for example `["organizationalUnit", "container", "user"]`. Matching is on the most-specific class, so `user` excludes computers. Omit to export every object type.
- `path` (String) Root object to export. Accepts a slash-delimited path relative to the domain root (for example `Contoso/Servers`), a relative or full distinguished name, or `""` (the default) for the domain root. The naming-context DNs from `adds_domain` (`configuration_path`, `schema_path`) are accepted too.
- `recursive` (Boolean) Export every object below `path` as well as `path` itself. Defaults to `false` (only `path`).

### Read-Only

- `hcl` (String) The exported objects rendered as `adds_acl` configuration, ready to write to a `.tf` file.
- `id` (String) Identifier of this export, derived from the resolved base path and selection.
- `objects` (Attributes List) The exported objects, as structured data mirroring the rendered `hcl`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--objects))

<a id="nestedatt--objects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `objects`

Read-Only:

- `ace` (Attributes List) The object's explicit, non-inherited ACEs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--objects--ace))
- `distinguished_name` (String) Full distinguished name of the object.
- `inheritance_blocked` (Boolean) Whether the object blocks inheritance of ACEs from above.
- `object_class` (String) Structural object class, for example `organizationalUnit`.
- `path` (String) Portable `target` used in the rendered `adds_acl` block.

<a id="nestedatt--objects--ace"></a>
### Nested Schema for `objects.ace`

Read-Only:

- `access` (String) `Allow` or `Deny`.
- `inheritance` (String) Inheritance flag, or empty for the object only.
- `inherited_object_type` (String) Resolved inherited object type, or empty.
- `object_type` (String) Resolved object type, or empty.
- `rights` (List of String) `ActiveDirectoryRights` values.
- `trustee` (String) Resolved trustee name, or SID when it cannot be resolved.
